BiblicalUsage: Jehoaddin is Jehoaddan, an Israelitess, the mother of Amaziah king of Judah. In 2 Kings 14:2, his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem. The fuller story is told on the Jehoaddan, Mother of Amaziah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jehoaddan matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
